title: Bold Nocturne Drops
descriptionHtml:
The Bold Nocturne link, worn at the ear. Each earring is a polished oval link on a post with a larger pavé set oval link hanging below it, the same links as our Bold Nocturne Chain and Bracelet. Bold enough to wear alone.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with the Bold Nocturne Chain or Bracelet.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 30mm
  • Construction: A polished oval link on a post, with a larger pavé set oval link hanging below
  • Stone: Clear cubic zirconia pavé
  • Closure: Post back
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
